_meta.description: sEEG depth-electrode lookup catalog. Geometry in mm (spacing = contact centre-to-centre; shaft_dia = insulating body OD) drives element classification. contact_sigma_S_per_m / shaft_sigma_S_per_m are the PHYSICAL bulk conductivities, provided for reference only: all contacts share the single SEEG_contact tag, so the FEM conductivity is set by SEEGMaterials (default 1e6 S/m equipotential limit / 1e-5 S/m insulator), not per part number. Override globally via place_seeg(materials=SEEGMaterials(...)).
_meta.sources: Ad-Tech Product Catalogue 2015; Goodfellow/CRC material data; Missey-2026 SI. See simnibs/simulation/seeg/README.md (R1).

BF10R-SP21X-0C3.notes: Study electrode family (R.AMY/R.HIPPO/R.OF). SP21X is an Ad-Tech BF build code, NOT 21 mm; spacing = 5 mm per electrode_config.json. Macros flush with shaft. Microwires (40 um) omitted from FEM geometry (~30x below mesh resolution).

RD10R-SP05X-000.notes: Study 'RD sEEG' type (R.STI, R.AT). SP##X = spacing in mm (3-8 offered).

SD10R-SP05X-000.notes: 1.12 mm OD, 390 mm total; exposed contact 2.41 mm / recording 2.29 mm; spacing 5 mm (SP05X) or 10 mm (SP10X).

DIXI-Microdeep-D08-15AM.notes: European 0.8/2.0/3.5 mm standard. Secondary catalog entry (study uses Ad-Tech).

PMT-Depthalon-2102.notes: 0.8 mm OD; contacts 1-2 mm; spacing 2.5/3.5/5 mm. Secondary catalog entry.
